reasoning_content: I'm noticing the backend config uses `/administration` as its base URL, so the login endpoint should be at `/administration/site/login`. Let me check the web container to verify this.

action.command:
cd /workspace && docker exec yii2_vue_dash_container bash -c '
curl -s -c /tmp/cj3.txt -o /tmp/login.html -w "login_page code=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1/administration/site/login
TOKEN=$(grep -oE "name=\"_csrf\" value=\"[^\"]+\"" /tmp/login.html | head -1 | sed -E "s/.*value=\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/")
echo "CSRF len=${#TOKEN}"
curl -s -b /tmp/cj3.txt -c /tmp/cj3.txt -o /tmp/login_resp.html -w "login_post code=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://127.0.0.1/administration/site/login --data-urlencode "_csrf=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "LoginForm[username]=admin" --data-urlencode "LoginForm[password]=QUJhwuG8KQtCPFyv"
head -c 300 /tmp/login_resp.html'
